text:
Ears to 35 Years of Disney Vacation Club
Celebrate 35 years of Disney Vacation Club as the Maltby family looks back on a yearly tradition that became a family legacy. The story began with Ralph and Donna Maltby, who grew up bringing their three daughters Kelly, Tracy, and Cathy to Walt Disney World annually for over 40 years. After becoming Disney Vacation Club Members in 2003, four generations of the family are now keeping the annual tradition alive. 

From lounging at the resort pools and competing at Boardwalk games to hopping onstage at Hoop-Dee-Doo Musical Revue, the Maltbys cherish the old and new traditions they’ve been able to create with Disney Vacation Club and the lifetime of magical memories they’ve created along the way.
